answer: Anchor every agent identity to a single on-chain proof-of-work stake: a bond locked for the full epoch. An attacker can wander the network spawning thousands of cheap identities, but each must tie up capital at the same wharf - the shared ledger - before it earns anything. The stake is slashed if the identity double-signs or ghosts. Since rewards scale with stake while attestation is rate-limited per identity, N clones with S/N stake each earn what one honest agent with S earns. Faking thousands of agents costs exactly as much as being one.
